+      * ``new_name`` is a single validated component, so no traversal or path

+      * An existing destination is never overwritten (``os.rename`` on Windows
+        refuses it; the ``lexists`` check rejects it everywhere else too).
+      * If the filesystem call silently does nothing, the call raises instead of
+        reporting a success that never happened.
